title: "IS-IS across FRR and cEOS"

# IS-IS across FRR and cEOS

IS-IS is the other link-state IGP you will meet in a professional design. This lab is two routers and one link so the NET, the level, and the adjacency are the whole story. SR Linux can join as a third node once the pair is up.

## Learning goals

By the end of this chapter you can:

- Assign an ISO NET on FRR and on cEOS
- Form a level-2 point-to-point adjacency
- Advertise a loopback without a `network` statement
- Read the difference between an OSPF area and an IS-IS level

## Topology

```yaml
name: isis
topology:
  kinds:
    arista_ceos:
      image: ceos:4.37.0F
      memory: 2G
    frr:
      image: quay.io/frrouting/frr:containerlab-10.7.1
  nodes:
    r-frr:
      kind: frr
      startup-config: r-frr.frr.conf
      daemons: [isisd]
    r-ceos:
      kind: arista_ceos
  links:
    - endpoints: ["r-frr:eth1", "r-ceos:eth1"]
```

## FRR

```text
frr defaults traditional
service integrated-vtysh-config
!
interface lo
 ip address 10.0.0.1/32
 ip router isis CORE
!
interface eth1
 ip address 10.1.0.1/30
 ip router isis CORE
 isis network point-to-point
!
router isis CORE
 is-type level-2-only
 net 49.0001.0000.0000.0001.00
!
```

## cEOS

```text
interface Loopback0
   ip address 10.0.0.2/32
   isis enable CORE
interface Ethernet1
   no switchport
   ip address 10.1.0.2/30
   isis enable CORE
   isis network point-to-point
router isis CORE
   net 49.0001.0000.0000.0002.00
   is-type level-2
```

Both NETs share area `49.0001`. The system id is the unique part. A duplicated system id will not form a healthy adjacency.

## Verify

```bash
docker exec clab-isis-r-frr vtysh -c "show isis neighbor"
docker exec clab-isis-r-frr vtysh -c "show ip route isis"
docker exec clab-isis-r-ceos Cli -c "show isis neighbors"
```

### Predict

- One adjacency, level 2, point-to-point.
- Each loopback is in the other router's IS-IS table.
- Changing FRR to `is-type level-1` while cEOS stays level-2 drops the adjacency. Matching levels brings it back.

## SR Linux, optional third

Add `r-srl` on `10.1.0.4/30` only after the pair is up, on a new link, with NET `49.0001.0000.0000.0003.00` and level 2. The instance path is under `network-instance default protocols isis`. Tab-complete `net` and `level-capability` on this image. If the leaf names differ, the FRR and cEOS pair is still the lab.
